description: This class includes the manufacture of carpets, rugs and textile floor coverings.
includes: manufacture of woven carpets and rugs
manufacture of tufted carpets and rugs
manufacture of carpets and rugs of needleloom felt and other needleloom products
manufacture of coconut, rush and similar floor coverings
manufacture of carpets of plaited or woven strips
excludes: manufacture of mats and matting, see 1629
manufacture of floor coverings of cork, see 1629
manufacture of resilient floor coverings such as vinyl, linoleum, see 2220
